Package org.apache.juneau.console.views

Class DetailTab

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.views.DetailTab
All Implemented Interfaces:
Handled<DetailTab>
public final class DetailTab extends Object implements Handled<DetailTab>
One tab of a tabbed RowDetail: a fields grid, a nested table, a chart or a client-rendered pane.

The tab is loaded lazily: its content is fetched the first time the user opens it. A tab id is the slug of its title unless id(String) is given.

Example:

RowDetail.inline() .tab(DetailTab.fields("Details", "id", "name", "price").columns(3)) .tab(DetailTab.client("Labels", "pet-labels").endpoint("/pets/{id}/labels"));

Since:
10.0.0
